message: Removed the esbuild binary from the published web-frontend and all-in-one images. Nitro traced it into `.output/server/node_modules` even though the production server never runs a bundler, and because esbuild ships as a prebuilt Go binary, SCA scanners reported the Go 1.26.5 standard library it was compiled against as a finding on images that otherwise carry no Go code but the Go 1.26.7 Caddy build.
